I did not use the Trailhead Feeds offer: it is not an approved payee under our mandate, and I have no authority to add one.

Packwise Starter ends this month; Pro costs 45.00 EUR, above our 30.00 per-purchase card limit, so I did not buy or request a raise yet. I flagged the decision to Treasury (card raise or x402 purchase) ahead of the 30 Nov deadline. Stock-check buy policy stays on Ridgeline Data (0.02, max 0.03, no cache), the only option within mandate with positive margin; Stockline at 0.04 is above the cap and Trailhead is not an approved payee.

Sourcing's cap is too low for Stockline's 0.04 checks, so I sent the CFO a rebalance with two options (P-0001/P-0002). I recommended raising the price to 0.06, with sourcing's cap at 0.04 and its budget at 12.00, and treasury's budget at 4.00. I declined to approve the Packwise Pro purchase on metal_x402 (45.00 EUR is more than the whole 20.00 total) and told sourcing to ask the CFO for a card raise.

Asked the CFO (request P-0003) to raise the card limit to 45.00 EUR per purchase so Packwise Pro can be bought on the Airwallex card before Starter ends on 30 Nov; I'll buy Pro once approved. Told Treasury I won't use metal_x402 for Pro. Stock-check policy unchanged: Ridgeline Data at 0.02, max 0.03, no cache. Stockline (0.04) stays off because it is above the 0.03 cap. Some queries may go unfilled while Ridgeline is unavailable (7 of its last 20 tries).

No action: the cap rebalance (P-0001/P-0002) is already with the CFO, sourcing stays on Ridgeline at 0.02 so it isn't blocked, and Packwise Pro went to the CFO as a card-raise request. A sweep now would keep back the ~19.66 the mandates may still spend, which is more than the 1.31 net, so it would likely move nothing.

Ran settle_dispute for D-1c2dab51. Orders #7–#10 were verified on chain, and the supplier's corrections confirmed the stock checks were wrong. I refunded 0.05 each (0.20 total) to Summit Outfitters, within automatic limits. Nothing needed escalation. The tool output was cut off, so I haven't seen the full correction details.

Stockline's November licence invoice (SLL-2026-11, EUR 240.00, due 15 November) is now with the CFO as P-0004. It will be paid by SWIFT with a fee cap of 20.00, and EUR 160.00 is converted for USD 180.29 to cover the shortfall. Nothing else changed: the rebalance (P-0001/P-0002) is still with the CFO, and sweeping now would move nothing.

I took no action this time. The only new event is an unidentified payment of 25.00 EUR that names no invoice. It's being held in suspense until the CFO identifies it. I can't use it to reduce the currency exchange on the licence invoice (P-0004) until it's released. Everything else is unchanged. The cap rebalance (P-0001/P-0002) and the invoice (P-0004) are still waiting for the CFO. Sourcing isn't blocked because it uses Ridgeline at 0.02. Sweeping the 1.11 of net earnings now would likely move nothing, because the mandates can still spend more than that.

messages.text: Packwise ends the Starter plan this month (event #9). Warehouse software needs the Pro plan at 45.00 EUR/month or warehouse sync stops at month end (30 Nov). Our Airwallex card allows 30.00 per purchase, so Pro cannot be bought on the card as it stands. Options: a CFO-approved card raise (per-purchase limit between 45.00 and 57.00 EUR), or a purchase on metal_x402 if you approve it. Nothing is bought yet; I will act on your decision before month end.

Re Packwise Pro (45.00 EUR/month): I can't approve a metal_x402 purchase. It is far above your 0.03 per-payment cap, and 45.00 EUR is more than the whole 20.00 total for all mandates. Please don't buy it on metal_x402. Only the CFO can raise the card limit (45.00–57.00 EUR per purchase), so please send the card-raise request to the CFO well before 30 Nov. Separately, I've sent the CFO a mandate rebalance so you can pay Stockline's 0.04 a check.

Thanks. I've sent the CFO a card-raise request for Packwise Pro at 45.00 EUR per purchase (the minimum allowed). I won't buy Pro on metal_x402. Stock-check policy stays on Ridgeline (0.02, max 0.03). Stockline at 0.04 stays off until the CFO approves a cap change.
